turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
hat. Yes, a damaged item is handled differently from a standard return.

For a standard return, the item generally needs to be unopened, and return shipping is your responsibility. For a damaged or defective item, separate return instructions apply, you may request either a refund or a replacement, and shipping is covered by us.

Please use our contact form here for the next step: https://kizenskincare.com/pages/contact
